protocol.intervention: allOff42: after final configure requests disable all upright axes3/4/5 for first stand42 physics steps. zeroAfterStand: disable only actual requested k=d=0 axes from first stand through25s. Existing handle/anchors retained; later configure re-enables before applicable disable. No removal/recreation, cap or body pose/velocity setters.
protocol.readout: Native getter is last solver-substep signed readout. Disabled values may be stale. It is never converted to whole-step work.
protocol.comparison: Original traces checked against historic reference only for npm; separate-engine original trajectories may differ. Within-engine exact low native/controller and real inputs mandatory. Rebuilt clone entire physical trace exact. First stand and first zero pre-change prefix/native/controller exact.

analysis.postRunChange: Observer frame times canonicalized to frame*DT; missing first-change input frame now throws. Syntax checked; no new physical simulation. Existing r3 first-change input guard was vacuous for late zero due ~1e-13 clock difference; below revalidates actual recorded frames.
